p2.disposition: Strip planEffect when storing/reading issued rows in memory, or reconstruct uniformly from the plan on all three backends. Do not treat readIssued as the settlement-link owner.

p2.finding: Browser v1→v2 createObjectStore(settlementPlans) plus exact four-store admission is implemented, but the focused 45-case inventory only pins a fresh v2 database. Safe in-place v1 migration is unexecuted in that suite.
p2.disposition: Add one retained/focused vector that opens a real v1 three-store authority with rows, migrates in place, and asserts version 2, four exact stores, and preserved issued/outbox/lineage rows.

p2.finding: applySettlementPlanEffect refuses absent, already-linked, and manual-review replacement targets, but will link an expire entry. Drain is supposed to skip expire issue; the store still accepts it.
p2.disposition: Refuse expire in applySettlementPlanEffect if the store is the fail-closed owner; otherwise keep drain-only and document the store as transport-neutral.
